intro.zh: 我是 Kuz，关注 AI 与真实业务之间的最后一公里。从全栈产品、Agent 工作流到算法实验，我把需求、数据、交互与交付连在一起。持续探索 RAG，让知识成为下一步行动的上下文。
intro.en: I'm Kuz. I focus on the last mile between AI and real-world work. From full-stack products and agent workflows to algorithm experiments, I connect requirements, data, interactions and delivery. I continue exploring RAG as a bridge from knowledge to action.

tagline.zh: 让内容流动，让结果可追溯。
tagline.en: Content in motion. Outcomes in view.

summary.zh: 把新闻采集、AI 内容处理、筛选去重、栏目投递与异常核查接成一条可运营的生产流水线。
summary.en: A production workflow connecting news collection, AI-assisted processing, filtering, deduplication, channel delivery and incident review.

role.zh: 全栈开发 · 工作流工程 · 发布与运维
role.en: Full-stack development · Workflow engineering · Release operations

problem.zh: 多来源内容与多目标栏目之间，人工搬运、重复投递和模糊回执会放大运营成本。
problem.en: Multiple sources and destinations create manual work, duplicate delivery and ambiguous receipts.

solution.zh: 通过 FastAPI、Vue 3 和持久任务队列组织 API、调度与 Worker；把投递对象、重试记录和接收证据连成可核查链路。
solution.en: FastAPI, Vue 3 and a persistent task queue coordinate APIs, scheduling and workers. Delivery targets, attempts and receipt evidence stay traceable.

outcome.zh: 形成有正式部署记录的新闻生产平台，支持异常中心、受控数据浏览与可回退发布；接收与客户端展示分别核验。
outcome.en: A documented production deployment with incident review, controlled data inspection and reversible releases. Receipt confirmation and client display are verified separately.

status.zh: 已部署 · 持续迭代

evidence.en: README and STATUS record deployment, rollback, tests and actual receipt evidence. This portfolio did not recheck production; historical unknown receipts and client-display acceptance remain separate.

tagline.zh: 让 AI 拥有上下文，也拥有边界。
tagline.en: Context for AI. Boundaries for trust.

summary.zh: 面向长期使用的个人知识与工作证据系统，把 Markdown 资产、Agent 工作流、持续归档与可审计回执组织起来。
summary.en: A long-lived knowledge and work-evidence system connecting Markdown assets, agent workflows, continuous archiving and auditable receipts.

role.zh: Agent 工作流设计 · 知识治理 · Python 自动化
role.en: Agent workflow design · Knowledge governance · Python automation

problem.zh: 对话、任务与项目记录分散，AI 摘要容易失去来源，长期记忆也容易把推测当事实。
problem.en: Conversations, tasks and project records fragment context; summaries can lose sources and memory can confuse inference with fact.

solution.zh: 建立渐进式读取入口、来源与敏感级别、采集租约、原子写入、周期重建和人工内容保护，并用测试约束工具行为。
solution.en: Progressive context entry points, source and sensitivity metadata, execution leases, atomic writes, period rebuilding and protected human edits constrain the workflow.

outcome.zh: 形成可持续维护的 Agent 协作底座：事实、摘要、计划与完成证据各有归属，失败与部分覆盖可被追踪。
outcome.en: A maintainable foundation for agent collaboration where facts, summaries, plans and completion evidence remain distinct, with traceable failures and partial coverage.

tagline.zh: 把讲解变成可编排的体验。
tagline.en: Turn narration into an orchestrated experience.

summary.en: A Windows application combining an overlay avatar, speech narration, node-based workflows and desktop/web interaction.

solution.en: Electron and a local Node service host the overlay and management UI; SQLite persists configuration, cached TTS supports fallback, and nodes coordinate clicks, highlights, narration and waits.

outcome.zh: 已有版本化安装与归档材料，支持节点、节点组、方案及工作流管理；目标大屏、DPI 与声音设备仍按现场环境验证。
outcome.en: Versioned installer and archive materials accompany node, group, plan and workflow management. Target displays, DPI and audio devices require environment-specific validation.

name.zh: 高光谱 · 图平滑与波段选择

tagline.zh: 从高维数据，找到有用信号。
tagline.en: Find useful signals in high-dimensional data.

summary.zh: 围绕高光谱遥感分类，将超像素、空间邻接图、图传播、谱聚类选带与分类评估连接成实验工程。
summary.en: An experimental pipeline connecting superpixels, spatial graphs, propagation, spectral-clustering band selection and hyperspectral classification.

role.zh: 算法实验 · 数据处理 · 结果分析
role.en: Algorithm experiments · Data processing · Result analysis

problem.zh: 高光谱影像维度高且存在冗余，比较方法时还需要处理数据划分、参数、消融与结果口径。
problem.en: Hyperspectral imagery has high dimensionality and redundancy; fair comparisons also require clear splits, parameters, ablations and metric definitions.

solution.zh: PCA 构造输入，SLIC 建立区域，再进行固定图传播与波段选择；通过 SVM/SAM、参数扫描和消融组织评估。
solution.en: PCA inputs feed SLIC regions, fixed graph propagation and band selection; SVM/SAM, parameter sweeps and ablations structure evaluation.

outcome.zh: 保留多组实验脚本与历史结果，为算法对照和复现提供清晰入口；固定传播并非可训练 GCN，历史指标不冒充新复现实绩。
outcome.en: Experiment scripts and historical outputs support comparison and reproduction. Fixed propagation is not a trainable GCN, and archived metrics are not presented as fresh results.

solution.en: Spring Boot, MyBatis and MySQL support the backend; Vue 3, Pinia and ECharts implement the storefront, merchant workspace and admin console.

outcome.zh: 形成三角色交易工程及 17 张业务表的结构说明；支付为模拟流水，物流由商家手工登记。

tagline.zh: 探索图像、声音与文本的共同表达。
tagline.en: Explore a shared representation of image, sound and text.

summary.zh: 通过网页接收图像、音频和文本，投影为特征向量，经注意力融合后展示统计、热力图与模态相似度。
summary.en: A web prototype projects image, audio and text inputs into feature vectors, then visualizes attention-based fusion, statistics and similarity.

name.zh: 密度峰值选带 · SVM 研究

tagline.zh: 把算法比较，变成可追溯实验。
tagline.en: Make algorithm comparisons traceable.

summary.zh: 用于论文研究的高光谱波段选择与分类实验，整理数据准备、固定划分、方法对照和历史分类报告。
summary.en: Hyperspectral band-selection and classification experiments for paper research, covering data preparation, fixed splits, method comparisons and archived reports.

role.zh: 算法实验与工具开发

problem.zh: 不同选带方法与波段数的实验容易混淆来源、参数与评价口径。
problem.en: Comparisons across selection methods and band counts can lose track of sources, parameters and metric definitions.

solution.zh: 组织密度峰值、信息量与聚类等方法，以固定参数 RBF-SVM 对照，保存波段索引、指标与混淆矩阵。
solution.en: Organizes density peaks, information-based methods and clustering with fixed-parameter RBF-SVM comparisons, band indices, metrics and confusion matrices.

outcome.zh: 建立算法与结果归档；DP 指密度峰值，已有结果不代表本轮重训，也不声称优于全波段基线。
outcome.en: A traceable algorithm and result archive. DP means Density Peaks; archived outputs are not fresh training or proof of superiority to the full-band baseline.

tagline.zh: 理解文件、密钥与存储的关系。
tagline.en: Understand files, keys and storage together.

summary.zh: Flask 文件管理教学原型，上传时以 AES 加密文件并用 RSA 包装密钥，下载时输入密码解锁关联私钥，支持文件列表、软删除和操作日志。
summary.en: A Flask teaching prototype that encrypts uploads with AES and wraps file keys with RSA, unlocks the associated private key by password for downloads, and provides lists, soft deletion and operation logs.

role.zh: Python Web 开发 · 密码库集成实践

problem.zh: 通过真实文件处理流程练习对称加密、非对称密钥包装、数据库元数据和网页交互。
problem.en: Practice symmetric encryption, asymmetric key wrapping, database metadata and web interaction through a concrete file workflow.

solution.en: PyCryptodome generates per-file AES-256 keys and IVs, encrypts with CBC, and wraps AES keys with RSA-2048/OAEP; Flask routes persist ciphertext/metadata and decrypt downloads.

outcome.zh: 形成混合加密与 Web 文件操作的学习案例；没有账号隔离和内容认证，共享活跃 RSA 密钥对，不作为生产安全存储承诺。
outcome.en: A learning case integrating hybrid encryption with web file operations. It lacks account isolation and content authentication and shares an active RSA key pair; it is not a production secure-storage guarantee.

solution.en: Draw the scene and snake in a JPanel; a Swing Timer calls movement, food and collision checks before rendering either the score or the game-over screen.

outcome.zh: 保存了可读的完整小游戏实现；没有暂停、重开菜单、难度或存档功能，边界判断和初始化仍有已知限制。
outcome.en: Preserves a readable small-game implementation. Pause, restart menus, difficulty levels and saved scores are absent; boundary and initialization limitations remain.

evidence.zh: 2026-10-30 通过已连接 GitHub 只读核对 README 与相关文件。已读取 README 与完整 GamePanel.java，确认移动、计分和事件流程；本轮未编译、未创建真实窗口或游玩。README 的既有离屏检查记录不等于本轮实机验收。
evidence.en: Read-only review through connected GitHub on 30 Oct 2026. Read README and the complete GamePanel.java, confirming movement, scoring and event flow. No compilation, live window or gameplay was performed in this review; historical off-screen checks are not a current desktop acceptance test.

name.zh: Python 基础与遥感学习集

tagline.zh: 从语言基础，走到图像分析。
tagline.en: From language fundamentals to image analysis.

summary.zh: Python 阶段练习与示例归档，覆盖基础语法、数据结构、函数、面向对象，以及 K-means、随机森林等遥感图像分析方法。
summary.en: An archive of Python exercises and examples covering syntax, data structures, functions, object-oriented programming, and remote-sensing methods including K-means and random forests.

role.zh: Python 与机器学习方法学习

problem.zh: 连接基础编程概念与多波段图像处理，理解数据变形、分类与评估的基本步骤。
problem.en: Connect programming fundamentals with multiband imagery, including data reshaping, classification and evaluation.

solution.zh: 按主题保留独立示例；图像分析脚本将多波段像素展开后调用 scikit-learn 分类，并示例 NDVI、形态学和纹理处理。
solution.en: Keeps independent topic-based examples. The image-analysis script flattens multiband pixels for scikit-learn classification and demonstrates NDVI, morphology and texture operations.

outcome.zh: 形成学习型代码资产，遥感演示入口使用随机模拟数据；不是已部署遥感平台，未证明真实数据精度或生产适用性。
outcome.en: Provides a learning code collection; the remote-sensing demonstration uses random synthetic input. It is not a deployed remote-sensing platform and does not establish real-data accuracy or production suitability.

status.zh: 学习示例归档 · test-1 分支

evidence.zh: 2026-10-30 通过已连接 GitHub 只读核对 README 与相关文件。读取 test-1 README、完整树清单、面向对象示例及图像分析脚本，确认 KMeans/RandomForestClassifier 调用；未运行脚本、训练或验证真实遥感数据，不采用 README 未核实的全量功能宣传。
evidence.en: Read-only review through connected GitHub on 30 Oct 2026. Read the test-1 README, complete tree, OOP example and image-analysis script, confirming KMeans and RandomForestClassifier calls. No scripts, training or real imagery were run; unverified broad README claims are not treated as delivered features.

name.zh: 高光谱遥感算法实验工程

tagline.zh: 在波段之间，寻找分类线索。
tagline.en: Finding classification signals across spectral bands.

summary.zh: 围绕多波段 TIF 影像组织 DP 密度峰值波段选择、LDA 变换、PyTorch CNN 分类及实验图表整理的多脚本研究练习。
summary.en: A multi-script research exercise for multiband TIF imagery, combining density-peaks band selection, LDA transformations, PyTorch CNN classification and experiment visualizations.

role.zh: 遥感算法实现与实验支撑

problem.zh: 高维波段存在冗余，需要选择代表性输入并比较不同波段配置的分类表现。
problem.en: High-dimensional spectral bands contain redundancy; representative inputs and classification behavior across band configurations need comparison.

solution.zh: DP 脚本以波段为样本计算密度与距离，按乘积分数选择波段；CNN 使用 5×5 图像块、卷积网络与训练/验证循环，导出曲线、指标和分类图。
solution.en: The DP script treats bands as samples and selects them using density-distance product scores. A CNN uses 5×5 patches, convolutional layers and training/validation loops, exporting curves, metrics and classification maps.

outcome.zh: 保留实验实现与历史材料，支持独立算法及辅助工具；本轮未复现实验，不将历史指标、论文发表或软著登记视为已验证成果。
outcome.en: Preserves experiment implementations and historical materials with standalone algorithms and helper tools. This review did not reproduce experiments or verify historical metrics, publications or software-copyright registration.

status.zh: 算法实验工程 · 待数据复现

evidence.zh: 2026-10-30 通过已连接 GitHub 只读核对 README 与相关文件。读取 README、完整 DP 脚本及 CNN 模型定义/训练与导出关键段。原始影像、真值与权重未在本轮准备；未启动训练、桌面工具或准确率复验，CNN 中间可视化方法未逐项执行。
evidence.en: Read-only review through connected GitHub on 30 Oct 2026. Read README, the complete DP script, and CNN model, training and export sections. Source imagery, ground truth and weights were not prepared; no training, desktop tools or accuracy reproduction was performed, and intermediate plotting methods were not executed.

summary.en: A collection of eight Word templates for software manuals, source-code documents, collaboration references and installation notes, intended for manual copying, completion and review.

role.zh: 文档模板整理与材料流程设计
role.en: Documentation curation and preparation workflow design

problem.en: Documentation spread across separate files can create inconsistencies between project facts, runtime requirements and manuals.

outcome.en: Provides reusable documentation starting points. It has no implemented automatic writing, source analysis, screenshot-layout or submission program, and is not counted as developed software, AI or an agent.

status.zh: 模板资料库 · 人工填写

evidence.zh: 2026-10-30 通过已连接 GitHub 只读核对 README 与相关文件。读取 README 和逐项模板目录；8份数量来自现有目录说明，本轮未打开二进制 Word 正文或渲染版式，也未生成或提交任何软著材料。未复制模板中的人员资料。
evidence.en: Read-only review through connected GitHub on 30 Oct 2026. Read README and the itemized template catalog. The eight-template count comes from that catalog; binary Word contents and rendered layouts were not reviewed, and no registration materials were generated or submitted. Personal details in templates were not copied.

tagline.zh: 先理解数据，再开始建模。
tagline.en: Understand the data before building a model.

summary.en: An archive of training and test CSVs for a Titanic survival-prediction exercise, with field, quality and usage documentation. It contains study data, not analysis code or trained models.

problem.zh: 开始二分类练习前，需要明确特征、目标标签、空值和训练/测试结构差异。
problem.en: Before a classification exercise, features, target labels, missing values and train/test structural differences must be understood.

solution.en: Keeps the labeled training table separate from the unlabeled test table, with documentation for field meanings, missing values and future verification.

outcome.zh: 为后续学习实验提供输入资料；没有预测服务、模型准确率或已完成算法实现，不计入 AI、算法软件或企业交付。
outcome.en: Provides input material for future learning experiments. It offers no prediction service, model accuracy result or completed algorithm implementation, and is not counted as AI software, an implemented algorithm or enterprise delivery.

evidence.zh: 2026-10-30 通过已连接 GitHub 只读核对 README 与相关文件。读取 README、数据字典及完整仓库树，确认仅数据与说明、无分析/训练源码；未读取或复制乘客逐条数据，未重算统计。来源渠道、许可与官方文件逐字节一致性仍未确认。

tagline.zh: 从一个联系人，练习完整的数据流。
tagline.en: A contact record as an end-to-end data-flow exercise.

summary.zh: Java Swing、JDBC 与 MySQL 构成的课程作业，围绕联系人新增、修改、删除、模糊搜索和姓名首字母分组练习桌面 CRUD。
summary.en: A coursework desktop CRUD application using Java Swing, JDBC and MySQL for contact creation, editing, deletion, fuzzy search and initial-letter grouping.

role.zh: Java 桌面界面与数据访问实现
role.en: Java desktop UI and data-access implementation

problem.zh: 把表格选择、编辑对话框、姓名首字母与数据库记录保持一致，形成可理解的分层数据流。
problem.en: Keep table selection, edit dialogs, name initials and database records aligned through a clear layered data flow.

solution.zh: 在 Swing 事件线程启动界面，通过实体、服务与 DAO 分层传递联系人；JDBC 参数化语句执行增删改和姓名/电话搜索，pinyin4j 提供首字母处理依赖。
solution.en: Starts the UI on the Swing event thread and passes contacts through model, service and DAO layers. Parameterized JDBC statements handle mutations and name/phone searches, with pinyin4j supporting initial-letter processing.

outcome.zh: 保留课程级桌面管理系统实现；不具备账号权限、Web API 或导入导出，本轮未连接数据库，也未确认真实 GUI 与 CRUD 流程通过。
outcome.en: Preserves a coursework-scale desktop management implementation. Authentication, web APIs and import/export are absent; this review did not connect to a database or verify a live GUI/CRUD workflow.

status.en: Coursework management app · Runtime verification pending

Read README, App.java, the complete ContactDAO.java and pom.xml, verifying the Swing entry point, parameterized CRUD and dependencies. Historical credential files were not read; no SQL, compilation, desktop app or database connection was executed.

name.zh: Kuz 个人作品集与电子简历

tagline.zh: 让工程经历，成为可维护的作品集。
tagline.en: Turn engineering experience into a maintainable portfolio.

summary.zh: 本地运行的中英双语个人作品集，串联职业定位、分类统计、项目故事和完整仓库索引；后台可编辑文字并管理图片、视频与播放章节。
summary.en: A locally hosted bilingual portfolio connecting professional positioning, category statistics, project stories and a complete repository index, with editable content, images, videos and playback chapters.

role.zh: 全栈应用与交互设计

problem.zh: 项目资料分散在不同仓库，静态简历难以呈现工程细节，也难以持续更新演示素材。
problem.en: Project materials are scattered across repositories, while static resumes make engineering details and ongoing demo updates hard to maintain.

solution.zh: 以 Node 原生 HTTP 和 ES Modules 构建展示页与本地编辑后台；用 JSON 管理双语内容，提供 GitHub 清单同步、媒体上传、视频节点以及 WebGL 与 Canvas 动效。
solution.en: Uses native Node HTTP and ES modules for the site and local editor, JSON for bilingual content, GitHub inventory sync, media uploads, video chapters and WebGL/Canvas motion.

outcome.zh: 提供可双击启动的本地应用与维护文档；保存包含修订冲突检查和旧版本备份，未作为公网多用户服务发布。
outcome.en: Provides a double-click local launcher and maintenance documentation. Saving includes revision checks and prior-version backups; it is not published as a public multi-user service.

status.zh: 本地应用 · 持续维护

evidence.zh: 核对本仓库 README、backend/server.mjs、frontend/app.js 与 sculpture-gl.js；本地监听、内容保存、媒体 Range 和动效实现均有源码。
